findings.summary: JobApplicationNavItem checks summaryStatus === "succeeded" but the AiJobApplicationSummaryStatus enum only has values "none", "current", "regenerating". The harvey dot will never render.
findings.detail: JobApplicationListContainer (line 222) passes jobApplication.aiJobApplicationSummaryStatus?.status as the summaryStatus prop. The AiJobApplicationSummaryStatus model enum (app/models/ai_job_application_summary_status.rb:7-11) defines status values as none (0), current (1), regenerating (2). The frontend type (app/javascript/shared/types/jobApplication.ts:4) matches: "none" | "current" | "regenerating". But JobApplicationNavItem line 26 compares summaryStatus === "succeeded" -- a value that does not exist in this enum. This is a leftover from the old AiJobApplicationSummary.status which had "succeeded" as a pipeline status. The check should be summaryStatus === "current" to show the harvey dot when a completed summary exists.
findings.trace: JobApplicationListContainer.tsx:222-223 -> JobApplicationNavItem.tsx:26 -> AiJobApplicationSummaryStatus model enum (none/current/regenerating) -> TypeScript type AiJobApplicationSummaryStatus.status (none/current/regenerating)

verified_correct.check: useAiJobApplicationSummary query key matches websocket invalidation
verified_correct.result: PASS. Hook uses query key ["aiJobApplicationSummary", aiJobApplicationSummaryId] (line 42). WebsocketJobChannelHandler invalidates ["aiJobApplicationSummary"] (line 75) which is a prefix match -- React Query prefix matching will invalidate all keys starting with "aiJobApplicationSummary". WebsocketGlobalChannelHandler (line 226) also invalidates ["aiJobApplicationSummary"]. useUpdateJobApplication (useJobApplication.ts:224) also invalidates ["aiJobApplicationSummary"]. All three invalidation sites use the same prefix.
